suggestions.quote: Fact: a person keeps about five very close people, about a hundred and fifty in all, and what limits it is time: every friendship costs hours to keep (c19).
suggestions.fix: Move this fact onto the night-bus journey so the bench scene spends the ammunition instead of pausing after its reveal.

suggestions.quote: The group chat for a week has been two machines congratulating each other.
suggestions.fix: Beat the obvious AI-loop gag: one aunt types “lovely,” her assistant expands it into an apology, and the other assistant accepts an offence neither aunt noticed.

keep.quote: She was keeping you with the only hours she had left: the ones she was asleep for.
Nobody wrote it. Both of you meant it.
A dot is a greeting card that hides the card.
